claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access within the Auction Administration application by listing all users and creating or editing user accounts.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access within the Auction Administration application by listing all users and creating or editing user accounts.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Administration application.
The Auctioneer has navigated to or selected the 'User Access Mgmt Page' from the main menu.
The Auctioneer selects the 'User Access Mgmt Page' from the Auction Admin Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the 'User Access Mgmt Page' from the Auction Admin Main Menu.

claims.content: The system displays the 'User Access Mgmt Page' with options to 'List All Users' and 'Create / Edit User'.
If the Auctioneer selects 'List All Users', the system displays a list of all existing user accounts.
If the Auctioneer selects 'Create / Edit User', the system navigates to the page for creating or editing a user account.
At any point, the Auctioneer can navigate back to the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page' to select a different administrative function.
The Auctioneer has successfully listed all users in the system.
A new user account has been created or an existing user account has been edited.
User access permissions within the Auction Administration application have been updated according to the Auctioneer's actions.
